# criblio_notifications (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_notifications" "example" {
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Worker Group ID.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `condition` (String) The condition that triggers the Notification. Use <code>GET /conditions</code> for a list of supported <code>condition</code> values.
- `conf` (Attributes) Configuration for the <code>condition</code> that triggers the Notification. Supported fields vary depending on the <code>condition</code>. Use <code>GET /conditions/{id}</code> to review the configuration for a specific <code>condition</code>. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--conf))
- `disabled` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, the Notification is disabled and the specified condition will not trigger it.
- `group` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Worker Group or Edge Fleet that the Notification applies to.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier.
- `metadata` (Attributes List) Metadata tags for the Notification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--metadata))
- `mode` (String) Delivery mode for Notifications.<br/><br/> <code>direct</code>: Notification is sent directly to Notification targets that are defined in <code>templateTargetPairs</code>.<br/><br/> <code>policy</code>: Notification is routed through Notification Policies, which match alerts by labels and route them to Notification targets without relying on <code>templateTargetPairs</code>.
- `pack` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Pack the Notification belongs to. Automatically populated and returned in responses.
- `target_configs` (Attributes List) Override settings to apply for each referenced Notification target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--target_configs))
- `target_details` (Attributes List) Additional details about referenced Notification targets. Optionally populated on request. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--target_details))
- `targets` (List of String) List of the <code>id</code> values for the Notification targets to send the Notification to.
- `template_target_pairs` (Attributes List) If <code>mode</code> is <code>direct</code>, the key-value pairs that define the Notification templates and targets to use for sending Notifications. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--template_target_pairs))

<a id="nestedatt--items--conf"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.conf`

Read-Only:

- `saved_query_id` (String) ID of the saved query this notification is associated with.
- `message` (String) Message template for the notification.
- `trigger` (String) Custom expression evaluated against Search results when triggerType is custom. Filters notification matches without removing saved query results.
- `trigger_type` (String) Type of trigger. Use custom to evaluate trigger against Search results, or resultsCount to compare the number of results.
- `trigger_comparator` (String) Comparison operator.
- `trigger_count` (Number) Threshold count for the trigger.
- `name` (String) Input or source ID for Stream notifications.
- `time_window` (String) Time window for the metric.
- `data_volume` (String) Data volume threshold.
- `notify_on_resolution` (Boolean) Notify when the condition returns to the resolved state.
- `usage_threshold` (Number) Persistent queue usage threshold.

<a id="nestedatt--items--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.metadata`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the metadata field.
- `value` (String) JavaScript expression to compute the metadata field's value, enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can evaluate to a constant.

<a id="nestedatt--items--target_configs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.target_configs`

Read-Only:

- `conf` (Attributes) Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) configuration for the Notification target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--target_configs--conf))
- `id` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Notification target.

<a id="nestedatt--items--target_configs--conf"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.target_configs.conf`

Read-Only:

- `body` (String) Email body.
- `email_recipient` (Attributes) Email recipient settings for the Notification target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--target_configs--conf--email_recipient))
- `subject` (String) Email subject.

<a id="nestedatt--items--target_configs--conf--email_recipient"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.target_configs.conf.email_recipient`

Read-Only:

- `bcc` (String) Bcc: Recipients' email addresses.
- `cc` (String) Cc: Recipients' email addresses.
- `to` (String) Recipients' email addresses.

<a id="nestedatt--items--target_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.target_details`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The type of the Notification target.

<a id="nestedatt--items--template_target_pairs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.template_target_pairs`
